title: THE DUST LAW'S INTERNAL CLOSURE: (c0, q) reconstructed from the physical chain ALONE (no fits) -- the self-consistency audit
question: does the dust law's (c0, q) reconstruct from its own pieces -- q = -1/3 (Bondi reservoir, G200/G210), c0 from the infall jump A_b = 0.6495 (G182/G185), p = 0.99 (framework r^-1, G139) -- with ZERO fitted constants, and does the fully-derived law reproduce the measured c0 = -0.1445 +- 0.0298 and the committed G122/G139/G220 comparisons?

p.from: the framework's r^-1 (G139 p* = 0.99; G143 measured 0.9904 +- 0.035)

c0.method: the G182/G185 infall jump A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = 0.6495 with rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b resolved through G139's density-space map M_dust(<r) = M_b(<r) a_c (r/R500)^-p (r/r_M) - M_ph(<r)

z_fold.statement: the (1+z)^3 assembly-time folding has the right sign; its activity level is UNDERDETERMINED at 0.52 sigma -- the one combined constant the chain cannot pin

verdicts.V1_all_origin_law: THE ALL-ORIGIN LAW: c_dust(M, r) = 10^{-0.070} (M/8e14)^(-0.333) (r/R500)^(-0.990) -- q = -1/3 from the G200/G210 Bondi reservoir (0.52 sigma), p = 0.99 the framework's r^-1 (G139), c0 = -0.0701 from the G182/G185 infall jump A_b = 0.6495 resolved through G139's density space map (rho_d(r_b) = rho_ph(r_b)/A_b): +2.50 sigma of the measured c0 = -0.1445 +- 0.0298 -- THE LAW WITH ZERO FITTED CONSTANTS, its normalization reconstructed from the physical chain.
verdicts.V2_closure_test: THE CLOSURE TEST: the 96-bin coherency curve closes at 0.135 dex with the fully-derived law (vs 0.119 dex at 3 fitted parameters -- ratio 1.14x); the density image reads p_dust,map = 1.58 (committed 1.55); the tSZ y-profiles land at median 2-bin -2.54 / pointwise -2.37, inside the G177 pass window, identical in branch to G220's committed (-2.54 / -2.37) -- the chain reproduces the measured c0 at +2.50 sigma and the measured q at 0.52 sigma: the dust law is closed from its own pieces.
verdicts.V3_honest_statement: THE HONEST STATEMENT: the fully-derived law stands AT the fits -- the zero-constant law closes the 96-bin curve to 0.135 dex (1.14x the 3-param rung), the tSZ branch is unchanged, and the sole carried residue is the registered pair: Delta q = -0.081 (0.52 sigma, the Bondi supply 0.52-sigma shallow) and Delta c0 = +0.074 (+2.50 sigma, the A_b 1.34x normalization).  The mechanism of the q-sliver is NAMED (the (1+z)^3 assembly-time z-fold, right sign) but its ACTIVITY LEVEL is UNDERDETERMINED at 0.52 sigma -- the one combined constant the chain still cannot pin is the z-fold's partial-activity fraction (f_z in [0.12, 0.35] over the committed band): INTERNAL CLOSURE HOLDING -- (c0, q, p) all derived, the residuals carried honestly, the underdetermined sliver named.
